# ngrrram

`ngrrram` is a CLI tool to practice typing ngrams (`n` adjacent symbols in
particular order) to improve your typing speed and/or learn new keyboard
layouts effectively.

![a showcase of the ngrrram ui](./.github/showcase.gif)

Certain letter combination occur a lot more often than others, thus practicing
these in particular makes sense. This type of practice is often recommended for
example by [Ben Vallack](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sI-a64EVPPU) and Josh
Kaufman, who [learned Colemak in just 20 hours](https://first20hours.com)
making strong use of ngrams.

There already exists a good tool for this type of practice called
[ngram-type](https://github.com/ranelpadon/ngram-type). This tool is *heavily*
inspired by `ngram-type` and I want to thank Ranel Padon for creating it.

However, ngram-type does not support emulating different keyboard layouts,
which I found important so I would not have to switch my whole system to a
layout I was still learning.

Also, some people might prefer local/offline CLI based solutions over web based
ones.

## Installation

### Releases

Precompiled [releases](https://github.com/wintermute-cell/ngrrram/releases) for
linux, windows and macos are available.

### AUR (maintained by [JinEnMok](https://github.com/JinEnMok))

Use `yay` or any other AUR helper to install for an Archlinux system:

```bash
yay -S ngrrram-git
or
yay -S ngrrram-bin
```

### From Source

Make sure you have the rust tooling installed, then simply run:

```bash
cargo build --release
```

The executable will then be located at `./target/release/ngrrram`

### Looking for help packaging!

If you'd like to help by packaging for your platform, I'd gladly accept!

## Usage

`ngrrram` is not very complex. It offers a few customization options as command
flags, but starts with the recommended defaults if unconfigured.

Options:
```
Usage: ngrrram [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -n, --n <2|3|4|w|file>  use bi-(2), tri-(3), tetragrams(4), (w)ords or comma separated wordlist file. [default: 2]
  -t, --top <1-200>       use the top X ngrams ordered by usage. [default: 50]
  -c, --combi <1-200>     how many different ngrams to use in a single lesson. [default: 2]
  -r, --rep <number>      how often to repeat *each* different ngram in a lesson. [default: 3]
  -w, --wpm <number>      the wpm threshold at which the lesson is considered a success. [default: 40]
  -a, --acc <0-100>       the accuracy in percent at which the lesson is considered a success. [default: 94]
      --emu-in <layout>   your current keyboard layout. only needed if you want to emulate a different layout. see docs for supported layouts. [default: ]
      --emu-out <layout>  the layout you want to emulate. only needed if you want to emulate a different layout. see docs for sup
</output_head>

</elided_chars>
<output_tail>

```

If you start `ngrrram` without parameters, it uses these recommended defaults:
```bash
ngrrram --n 2 --top 50 --combi 2 --rep 3 --wpm 40 --acc 100
```

## Layout Emulation

To emulate a different keyboard layout in `ngrrram`, you must pass the flags
`--emu-in` and `--emu-out`, the first one describing your current layout, and
the second one being the one you want to emulate.

Available layouts are:

- `qwerty`    (Qwerty)
- `qwertz`    (Qwertz)
- `azerty`    (Azerty)
- `dvorak`    (Dvorak)
- `colemak`   (Colemak)
- `colemakdh` (ColemakDH)

- The WPM timer for each lesson only starts once you type the first letter of

- Every 5 non-space characters are considered a "word" for the WPM calculation.
  Otherwise WPM would unnaturally skyrocket with smaller ngrams.

class CliExit(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: int):
        self.code = code


def prog_name() -> str:
    return os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]) or "executable"


def help_text() -> str:
    p = prog_name()
    return f"""Usage: {p} [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -n, --n <2|3|4|w|file>  use bi-(2), tri-(3), tetragrams(4), (w)ords or comma separated wordlist file. [default: 2]
  -t, --top <1-200>       use the top X ngrams ordered by usage. [default: 50]
  -c, --combi <1-200>     how many different ngrams to use in a single lesson. [default: 2]
  -r, --rep <number>      how often to repeat *each* different ngram in a lesson. [default: 3]
  -w, --wpm <number>      the wpm threshold at which the lesson is considered a success. [default: 40]
  -a, --acc <0-100>       the accuracy in percent at which the lesson is considered a success. [default: 94]
      --emu-in <layout>   your current keyboard layout. only needed if you want to emulate a different layout. see docs for supported layouts. [default: ]
      --emu-out <layout>  the layout you want to emulate. only needed if you want to emulate a different layout. see docs for supported layouts. [default: ]
      --show-ortho        show keyboard in ortholinear format
      --nokb              pass this flag to disable the keyboard layout display.
      --cat               the most important flag. don't practice alone.
  -h, --help              Print help
"""


def eprint(s: str) -> None:
    sys.stderr.write(s)
    if not s.endswith("\n"):
        sys.stderr.write("\n")


def parse_error(msg: str, usage: str | None = None) -> None:
    p = prog_name()
    text = f"error: {msg}\n\n"
    if usage is not None:
        text += f"Usage: {p} {usage}\n\n"
    text += "For more information, try '--help'.\n"
    eprint(text)
    raise CliExit(2)


def invalid_value(opt_display: str, value: str, reason: str) -> None:
    parse_error(f"invalid value '{value}' for '{opt_display}': {reason}", None)


def missing_value(key: str) -> None:
    parse_error(f"a value is required for '{LONG_FOR_KEY[key]}' but none was supplied", None)


def duplicate(key: str) -> None:
    parse_error(f"the argument '{LONG_FOR_KEY[key]}' cannot be used multiple times", "[OPTIONS]")


def unexpected(arg: str, usage: str = "[OPTIONS]", tip: str | None = None) -> None:
    p = prog_name()
    text = f"error: unexpected argument '{arg}' found\n\n"
    if tip:
        text += f"  tip: a similar argument exists: '{tip}'\n\n"
    text += f"Usage: {p} {usage}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
    eprint(text)
    raise CliExit(2)


def flag_value(name: str, val: str) -> None:
    parse_error(f"unexpected value '{val}' for '--{name}' found; no more were expected", f"--{name}")


def opt_display_for_long(name: str) -> str:
    if name in VALUE_LONGS:
        key, value_name = VALUE_LONGS[name]
        return f"--{name} {value_name}"
    return f"--{name}"


def is_known_option_token(tok: str) -> bool:
    if tok == "--":
        return True
    if tok.startswith("--"):
        nm = tok[2:].split("=", 1)[0]
        return nm in VALUE_LONGS or nm in FLAG_LONGS or nm == "help"
    if tok.startswith("-") and len(tok) >= 2:
        return tok[1] in SHORTS or tok[1] == "h"
    return False


def parse_i32(value: str, opt_display: str) -> int:
    if value == "":
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "cannot parse integer from empty string")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", value):
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "invalid digit found in string")
    # Mimic clap/Rust i32 parsing messages for the common cases.
    signless = value[1:] if value[:1] in "+-" else value
    try:
        n = int(value, 10)
    except Exception:
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "number too large to fit in target type")
    if n > 9223372036854775807:
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "number too large to fit in target type")
    if n < -9223372036854775808:
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "number too small to fit in target type")
    if n < -2147483648 or n > 2147483647:
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, f"{value} is not in -2147483648..=2147483647")
    return n


def set_value(opts: Opts, seen: set[str], key: str, value: str) -> None:
    if key in seen:
        duplicate(key)
    seen.add(key)
    if key in {"top", "combi", "rep", "wpm", "acc"}:
        display = LONG_FOR_KEY[key]
        setattr(opts, key, parse_i32(value, display))
    else:
        setattr(opts, key, value)


def set_flag(opts: Opts, seen: set[str], key: str) -> None:
    if key in seen:
        duplicate(key)
    seen.add(key)
    setattr(opts, key, True)


def suggestion_for(name: str) -> str | None:
    # A deliberately small approximation of clap's suggestions that matches the
    # common cases observed for this program.
    if name.startswith("hel"):
        return "--help"
    if name.startswith("nok"):
        return "--nokb"
    if name.startswith("sho"):
        return "--show-ortho"
    if name.startswith("n"):
        return "--n"
    return None


def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> Opts:
    opts = Opts()
    seen: set[str] = set()
    i = 1
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        if arg == "--":
            if i + 1 < len(argv):
                unexpected(argv[i + 1])
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--") and arg != "--":
            raw = arg[2:]
            if "=" in raw:
                name, val = raw.split("=", 1)
                has_value = True
            else:
                name, val = raw, None
                has_value = False
            if name == "help":
                if has_value:
                    flag_value("help", val or "")
                sys.stdout.write(help_text())
                raise CliExit(0)
            if name in FLAG_LONGS:
                if has_value:
                    flag_value(name, val or "")
                set_flag(opts, seen, FLAG_LONGS[name])
                i += 1
                continue
            if name in VALUE_LONGS:
                key, _ = VALUE_LONGS[name]
                if not has_value:
                    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                        missing_value(key)
                    nxt = argv[i + 1]
                    if nxt.startswith("-"):
                        if is_known_option_token(nxt):
                            missing_value(key)
                        else:
                            unexpected(nxt)
                    val = nxt
                    i += 1
                set_value(opts, seen, key, val if val is not None else "")
                i += 1
                continue
            sug = suggestion_for(name)
            if sug:
                usage = "--help" if sug == "--help" else "<--n <2|3|4|w|file>|--top <1-200>|--combi <1-200>|--rep <number>|--wpm <number>|--acc <0-100>|--emu-in <layout>|--emu-out <layout>|--show-ortho|--nokb|--cat>"
                unexpected("--" + name, usage, sug)
            unexpected("--" + name)
        elif arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
            ch = arg[1:2]
            rest = arg[2:]
            if ch == "h":
                sys.stdout.write(help_text())
                raise CliExit(0)
            if ch not in SHORTS:
                unexpected("-" + ch)
            key = SHORTS[ch]
            if rest.startswith("="):
                value = rest[1:]
            elif rest:
                value = rest
            else:
                if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                    missing_value(key)
                nxt = argv[i + 1]
                if nxt.startswith("-"):
                    if is_known_option_token(nxt):
                        missing_value(key)
                    else:
                        unexpected(nxt)
                value = nxt
                i += 1
            set_value(opts, seen, key, value)
            i += 1
        else:
            unexpected(arg)

    # Custom post-parse validation order observed from the binary.
    if not (1 <= opts.top <= 200):
        print("Invalid argument for top. Use a number between 1 and 200.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if not (1 <= opts.combi <= 200):
        print("Invalid argument for combi. Use a number between 1 and 200.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if not (1 <= opts.rep <= 200):
        print("Invalid argument for rep. Use a number between 1 and 200.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if not (1 <= opts.wpm <= 200):
        print("Invalid argument for wpm. Use a number between 1 and 200.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if not (0 <= opts.acc <= 100):
        print("Invalid argument for acc. Use a number between 0 and 100.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if (opts.emu_in == "") ^ (opts.emu_out == ""):
        print("You need to specify both emu_in and emu_out.")
        raise CliExit(1)

    if opts.n == "2":
        opts.pool = BIGRAMS
    elif opts.n == "3":
        opts.pool = TRIGRAMS
    elif opts.n == "4":
        opts.pool = TETRAGRAMS
    elif opts.n == "w":
        opts.pool = WORDS
    else:
        try:
            with open(opts.n, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = f.read()
        except OSError:
            print(f"File not found: {opts.n}")
            raise CliExit(1)
        pool: list[str] = []
        for line in data.splitlines():
            pool.extend(line.split(","))
        opts.pool = pool
    return opts


def fill_inner(s: str) -> str:
    if len(s) > INNER:
        return s[:INNER]
    return s + " " * (INNER - len(s))


def box(s: str) -> str:
    return "│" + fill_inner(s) + "│"


def center_inner(s: str, width: int = INNER) -> str:
    if len(s) > width:
        return s[:width]
    left = (width - len(s)) // 2
    return " " * left + s + " " * (width - len(s) - left)


def top_border() -> str:
    return "╭" + "─" * 65 + " Quit <esc> ╮"


def sep() -> str:
    return "│" + "─" * INNER + "│"


def bottom() -> str:
    return "╰" + "─" * INNER + "╯"


def title_line() -> str:
    return box(" " * 34 + "ngrrram!   by winterveil")


def lesson_line(num: int, ok: int, fail: int) -> str:
    left = f"    Lesson #{num}"
    right = f"✔: {ok}, ✘: {fail}    "
    return "│" + left + " " * max(0, INNER - len(left) - len(right)) + right + "│"


def stat_wpm(opts: Opts, avg: int, last: int) -> str:
    return box(f"  need >= {opts.wpm:3d}WPM,   avg. {avg:3d}WPM,   last {last:3d}WPM")


def stat_acc(opts: Opts, avg: int, last: int) -> str:
    return box(f"  need >= {opts.acc:3d}% Acc, avg. {avg:3d}% Acc, last {last:3d}% Acc")


def hline_keys(n: int, left: str, mid: str, right: str) -> str:
    return left + ("───" + mid) * (n - 1) + "───" + right


def key_row(keys: list[str]) -> str:
    return "│ " + " │ ".join(keys) + " │"


def layout_rows(name: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], list[str]]:
    return LAYOUTS.get(name, LAYOUTS["qwerty"])


def kb_lines(layout_name: str, ortho: bool, cat: bool) -> list[str]:
    top, home, bot = layout_rows(layout_name)
    lines: list[str] = []
    if ortho:
        r1 = top[:12]
        r2 = (home + ["△"] * 12)[:12]
        r3 = (bot + ["△"] * 12)[:12]
        indent = " " * 13
        lines.append(box(indent + hline_keys(12, "┌", "┬", "┐")))
        lines.append(box(indent + key_row(r1)))
        lines.append(box(indent + hline_keys(12, "├", "┼", "┤")))
        lines.append(box(indent + key_row(r2)))
        lines.append(box(indent + hline_keys(12, "├", "┼", "┤")))
        lines.append(box(indent + key_row(r3)))
        lines.append(box(indent + hline_keys(12, "└", "┴", "┘")))
        return lines

    if not cat:
        lines.append(box(" " * 13 + hline_keys(12, "┌", "┬", "┐")))
        lines.append(box(" " * 13 + key_row(top)))
        lines.append(box(" " * 13 + "└┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┘"))

def map_char(ch: str, opts: Opts) -> str:
    if not opts.emu_in and not opts.emu_out:
        return ch
    if ch == " ":
        return ch
    in_rows = layout_rows(opts.emu_in)
    out_rows = layout_rows(opts.emu_out)
    lower = ch.lower()
    for r, row in enumerate(in_rows):
        for c, val in enumerate(row):
            if lower == val and c < len(out_rows[r]):
                out = out_rows[r][c]
                return out.upper() if ch.isupper() else out
    return ch


def new_target(opts: Opts) -> str:
    pool = opts.pool
    if not pool:
        # The original panics eventually for an empty list; a blank target keeps
        # the UI alive and is friendlier for this reimplementation.
        return ""
    usable = pool[: min(opts.top, len(pool))]
    chosen = [random.choice(usable) for _ in range(opts.combi)]
    seq = chosen * opts.rep
    return " ".join(seq) + " "


def target_and_input_visual(target: str, typed: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if not target:
        return "", ""
    t_chars: list[str] = []
    u_chars: list[str] = []
    n = max(len(target), len(typed))
    for i in range(n):
        tc = target[i] if i < len(target) else " "
        uc = typed[i] if i < len(typed) else ""
        wrong = bool(uc) and uc != tc
        if tc == " " and wrong:
            t_chars.append("•")
        else:
            t_chars.append(tc)
        if wrong:
            u_chars.append("•" if uc == " " else uc)
        else:
            u_chars.append(" ")
    # Preserve alignment for typed feedback but do not show the final separating
    # blank before anything has been typed, matching the captured plain screen.
    if not typed:
        return target.rstrip(), ""
    return "".join(t_chars), "".join(u_chars)

            s2 = f"  need >= {opts.acc:3d}% Acc, avg. {avg_acc:3d}% Acc, last {last_acc:3d}% Acc"
            lines.append(box(fill_inner(s1)[:70] + "\\\\     "))
            lines.append(box(fill_inner(s2)[:70] + "V     "))
            lines.append(bottom())
        else:
            lines.append(sep())
            lines.append(stat_wpm(opts, avg_wpm, last_wpm))
            lines.append(stat_acc(opts, avg_acc, last_acc))

    else:

def terminal_failure() -> None:
    sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?1049h")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    sys.stderr.write('Error: Os { code: 6, kind: Uncategorized, message: "No such device or address" }\n')
    sys.stderr.flush()
    raise CliExit(1)


def run_tui(opts: Opts) -> int:
    if not sys.stdin.isatty():
        terminal_failure()
    try:
        old = termios.tcgetattr(sys.stdin.fileno())
    except Exception:
        terminal_failure()

    target = new_target(opts)
    typed = ""
    lesson = 1
    ok = fail = 0
    wpms: list[int] = []
    accs: list[int] = []
    last_wpm = last_acc = 0
    started: float | None = None
    total_events = 0
    wrong_events = 0

    sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?1049h\x1b[2J\x1b[1;1H")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    try:
        tty.setraw(sys.stdin.fileno())
        render(opts, target, typed, lesson, ok, fail, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        while True:
            r, _, _ = select.select([sys.stdin], [], [], 0.25)
            if not r:
                continue
            data = os.read(sys.stdin.fileno(), 32)
            if not data:
                break
            try:
                text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
            except Exception:
                text = ""
            redraw = False
            for ch in text:
                if ch == "\x1b":
                    return 0
                if ch in ("\r", "\n", "\t"):
                    continue
                if ch in ("\x7f", "\b"):
                    if typed:
                        typed = typed[:-1]
                        total_events += 1
                        redraw = True
                    continue
                if not ch.isprintable() and ch != " ":
                    continue
                if len(typed) >= len(target) and typed != target:
                    continue
                mapped = map_char(ch, opts)
                if started is None:
                    started = time.time()
                if len(typed) < len(target):
                    if mapped != target[len(typed)]:
                        wrong_events += 1
                    typed += mapped
                    total_events += 1
                    redraw = True
                if target and typed == target:
                    elapsed = max(time.time() - (started or time.time()), 0.001)
                    non_space = sum(1 for c in target if c != " ")
                    last_wpm = int(round((non_space / 5.0) / (elapsed / 60.0)))
                    if total_events <= 0:
                        last_acc = 100
                    else:
                        last_acc = int(round(100.0 * max(0, total_events - wrong_events) / total_events))
                    wpms.append(last_wpm)
                    accs.append(last_acc)
                    if last_wpm >= opts.wpm and last_acc >= opts.acc:
                        ok += 1
                    else:
                        fail += 1
                    lesson += 1
                    target = new_target(opts)
                    typed = ""
                    started = None
                    total_events = 0
                    wrong_events = 0
                    redraw = True
            if redraw:
                avg_wpm = int(round(sum(wpms) / len(wpms))) if wpms else 0
                avg_acc = int(round(sum(accs) / len(accs))) if accs else 0
                render(opts, target, typed, lesson, ok, fail, avg_wpm, last_wpm, avg_acc, last_acc)
    finally:
        try:
            termios.tcsetattr(sys.stdin.fileno(), termios.TCSADRAIN, old)
        except Exception:
            pass
        sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?1049l\x1b[?25h")
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    try:
        opts = parse_args(sys.argv)
        return run_tui(opts)
    except CliExit as e:
        return e.code
    except BrokenPipeError:
        return 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def parse_i32(value: str, opt_display: str) -> int:
    if value == "":
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "cannot parse integer from empty string")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", value):
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "invalid digit found in string")
    # Mimic clap/Rust i32 parsing messages for the common cases.
    signless = value[1:] if value[:1] in "+-" else value
    try:
        n = int(value, 10)
    except Exception:
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "number too large to fit in target type")
    if n > 9223372036854775807:
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "number too large to fit in target type")
    if n < -9223372036854775808:
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, "number too small to fit in target type")
    if n < -2147483648 or n > 2147483647:
        invalid_value(opt_display, value, f"{value} is not in -2147483648..=2147483647")
    return n


def set_value(opts: Opts, seen: set[str], key: str, value: str) -> None:
    if key in seen:
        duplicate(key)
    seen.add(key)
    if key in {"top", "combi", "rep", "wpm", "acc"}:
        display = LONG_FOR_KEY[key]
        setattr(opts, key, parse_i32(value, display))
    else:
        setattr(opts, key, value)


def set_flag(opts: Opts, seen: set[str], key: str) -> None:
    if key in seen:
        duplicate(key)
    seen.add(key)
    setattr(opts, key, True)


def suggestion_for(name: str) -> str | None:
    # A deliberately small approximation of clap's suggestions that matches the
    # common cases observed for this program.
    if name.startswith("hel"):
        return "--help"
    if name.startswith("nok"):
        return "--nokb"
    if name.startswith("sho"):
        return "--show-ortho"
    if name.startswith("n"):
        return "--n"
    return None


def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> Opts:
    opts = Opts()
    seen: set[str] = set()
    i = 1
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        if arg == "--":
            if i + 1 < len(argv):
                unexpected(argv[i + 1])
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--") and arg != "--":
            raw = arg[2:]
            if "=" in raw:
                name, val = raw.split("=", 1)
                has_value = True
            else:
                name, val = raw, None
                has_value = False
            if name == "help":
                if has_value:
                    flag_value("help", val or "")
                sys.stdout.write(help_text())
                raise CliExit(0)
            if name in FLAG_LONGS:
                if has_value:
                    flag_value(name, val or "")
                set_flag(opts, seen, FLAG_LONGS[name])
                i += 1
                continue
            if name in VALUE_LONGS:
                key, _ = VALUE_LONGS[name]
                if not has_value:
                    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                        missing_value(key)
                    nxt = argv[i + 1]
                    if nxt.startswith("-"):
                        if is_known_option_token(nxt):
                            missing_value(key)
                        else:
                            unexpected(nxt)
                    val = nxt
                    i += 1
                set_value(opts, seen, key, val if val is not None else "")
                i += 1
                continue
            sug = suggestion_for(name)
            if sug:
                usage = "--help" if sug == "--help" else "<--n <2|3|4|w|file>|--top <1-200>|--combi <1-200>|--rep <number>|--wpm <number>|--acc <0-100>|--emu-in <layout>|--emu-out <layout>|--show-ortho|--nokb|--cat>"
                unexpected("--" + name, usage, sug)
            unexpected("--" + name)
        elif arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
            ch = arg[1:2]
            rest = arg[2:]
            if ch == "h":
                sys.stdout.write(help_text())
                raise CliExit(0)
            if ch not in SHORTS:
                unexpected("-" + ch)
            key = SHORTS[ch]
            if rest.startswith("="):
                value = rest[1:]
            elif rest:
                value = rest
            else:
                if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                    missing_value(key)
                nxt = argv[i + 1]
                if nxt.startswith("-"):
                    if is_known_option_token(nxt):
                        missing_value(key)
                    else:
                        unexpected(nxt)
                value = nxt
                i += 1
            set_value(opts, seen, key, value)
            i += 1
        else:
            unexpected(arg)

    # Custom post-parse validation order observed from the binary.
    if not (1 <= opts.top <= 200):
        print("Invalid argument for top. Use a number between 1 and 200.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if not (1 <= opts.combi <= 200):
        print("Invalid argument for combi. Use a number between 1 and 200.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if not (1 <= opts.rep <= 200):
        print("Invalid argument for rep. Use a number between 1 and 200.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if not (1 <= opts.wpm <= 200):
        print("Invalid argument for wpm. Use a number between 1 and 200.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if not (0 <= opts.acc <= 100):
        print("Invalid argument for acc. Use a number between 0 and 100.")
        raise CliExit(1)
    if (opts.emu_in == "") ^ (opts.emu_out == ""):
        print("You need to specify both emu_in and emu_out.")
        raise CliExit(1)

    if opts.n == "2":
        opts.pool = BIGRAMS
    elif opts.n == "3":
        opts.pool = TRIGRAMS
    elif opts.n == "4":
        opts.pool = TETRAGRAMS
    elif opts.n == "w":
        opts.pool = WORDS
    else:
        try:
            with open(opts.n, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = f.read()
        except OSError:
            print(f"File not found: {opts.n}")
            raise CliExit(1)
        pool: list[str] = []
        for line in data.splitlines():
            pool.extend(line.split(","))
        opts.pool = pool
    return opts


def fill_inner(s: str) -> str:
    if len(s) > INNER:
        return s[:INNER]
    return s + " " * (INNER - len(s))


def box(s: str) -> str:
    return "│" + fill_inner(s) + "│"


def center_inner(s: str, width: int = INNER) -> str:
    if len(s) > width:
        return s[:width]
    left = (width - len(s)) // 2
    return " " * left + s + " " * (width - len(s) - left)


def top_border() -> str:
    return "╭" + "─" * 65 + " Quit <esc> ╮"


def sep() -> str:
    return "│" + "─" * INNER + "│"


def bottom() -> str:
    return "╰" + "─" * INNER + "╯"


def title_line() -> str:
    return box(" " * 34 + "ngrrram!   by winterveil")


def lesson_line(num: int, ok: int, fail: int) -> str:
    left = f"    Lesson #{num}"
    right = f"✔: {ok}, ✘: {fail}    "
    return "│" + left + " " * max(0, INNER - len(left) - len(right)) + right + "│"


def stat_wpm(opts: Opts, avg: int, last: int) -> str:
    return box(f"  need >= {opts.wpm:3d}WPM,   avg. {avg:3d}WPM,   last {last:3d}WPM")


def stat_acc(opts: Opts, avg: int, last: int) -> str:
    return box(f"  need >= {opts.acc:3d}% Acc, avg. {avg:3d}% Acc, last {last:3d}% Acc")


def hline_keys(n: int, left: str, mid: str, right: str) -> str:
    return left + ("───" + mid) * (n - 1) + "───" + right


def key_row(keys: list[str]) -> str:
    return "│ " + " │ ".join(keys) + " │"


def layout_rows(name: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], list[str]]:
    return LAYOUTS.get(name, LAYOUTS["qwerty"])


def kb_lines(layout_name: str, ortho: bool, cat: bool) -> list[str]:
    top, home, bot = layout_rows(layout_name)
    lines: list[str] = []
    if ortho:
        r1 = top[:12]
        r2 = (home + ["△"] * 12)[:12]
        r3 = (bot + ["△"] * 12)[:12]
        indent = " " * 13
        lines.append(box(indent + hline_keys(12, "┌", "┬", "┐")))
        lines.append(box(indent + key_row(r1)))
        lines.append(box(indent + hline_keys(12, "├", "┼", "┤")))
        lines.append(box(indent + key_row(r2)))
        lines.append(box(indent + hline_keys(12, "├", "┼", "┤")))
        lines.append(box(indent + key_row(r3)))
        lines.append(box(indent + hline_keys(12, "└", "┴", "┘")))
        return lines

    if not cat:
        lines.append(box(" " * 13 + hline_keys(12, "┌", "┬", "┐")))
        lines.append(box(" " * 13 + key_row(top)))
        lines.append(box(" " * 13 + "└┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┘"))
        lines.append(box(" " * 14 + key_row(home)))
        lines.append(box(" " * 14 + "└┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┘"))
        lines.append(box(" " * 15 + key_row(bot)))
        lines.append(box(" " * 15 + hline_keys(10, "└", "┴", "┘")))
        return lines

    # Keyboard plus cat art; the art is intentionally static while the original
    # animates subtly.  Text positions match the observed initial frame.
    lines.append(box(" " * 5 + hline_keys(12, "┌", "┬", "┐")))
    lines.append(box(" " * 5 + key_row(top)))
    lines.append(box(fill_inner(" " * 5 + "└┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┘")[:62] + "/\\_/\\        "))
    lines.append(box(fill_inner(" " * 6 + key_row(home))[:62] + ">(•༝• )<      "))
    lines.append(box(fill_inner(" " * 6 + "└┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┴┬──┘")[:62] + "|    \\       "))
    lines.append(box(fill_inner(" " * 7 + key_row(bot))[:62] + "|| |  )      "))
    lines.append(box(fill_inner(" " * 7 + hline_keys(10, "└", "┴", "┘"))[:62] + "ll-l-//      "))
    return lines


def map_char(ch: str, opts: Opts) -> str:
    if not opts.emu_in and not opts.emu_out:
        return ch
    if ch == " ":
        return ch
    in_rows = layout_rows(opts.emu_in)
    out_rows = layout_rows(opts.emu_out)
    lower = ch.lower()
    for r, row in enumerate(in_rows):
        for c, val in enumerate(row):
            if lower == val and c < len(out_rows[r]):
                out = out_rows[r][c]
                return out.upper() if ch.isupper() else out
    return ch


def new_target(opts: Opts) -> str:
    pool = opts.pool
    if not pool:
        # The original panics eventually for an empty list; a blank target keeps
        # the UI alive and is friendlier for this reimplementation.
        return ""
    usable = pool[: min(opts.top, len(pool))]
    chosen = [random.choice(usable) for _ in range(opts.combi)]
    seq = chosen * opts.rep
    return " ".join(seq) + " "


def target_and_input_visual(target: str, typed: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if not target:
        return "", ""
    t_chars: list[str] = []
    u_chars: list[str] = []
    n = max(len(target), len(typed))
    for i in range(n):
        tc = target[i] if i < len(target) else " "
        uc = typed[i] if i < len(typed) else ""
        wrong = bool(uc) and uc != tc
        if tc == " " and wrong:
            t_chars.append("•")
        else:
            t_chars.append(tc)
        if wrong:
            u_chars.append("•" if uc == " " else uc)
        else:
            u_chars.append(" ")
    # Preserve alignment for typed feedback but do not show the final separating
    # blank before anything has been typed, matching the captured plain screen.
    if not typed:
        return target.rstrip(), ""
    return "".join(t_chars), "".join(u_chars)


def render(opts: Opts, target: str, typed: str, lesson: int, ok: int, fail: int,
           avg_wpm: int, last_wpm: int, avg_acc: int, last_acc: int) -> None:
    lines: list[str] = [top_border(), title_line(), sep(), lesson_line(lesson, ok, fail), sep(), box("")]
    tv, uv = target_and_input_visual(target, typed)
    lines.append(box(center_inner(tv)))
    lines.append(box(center_inner(uv)))
    if not opts.nokb:
        lines.extend(kb_lines(opts.emu_out or "qwerty", opts.show_ortho, opts.cat))
        if opts.cat:
            lines.append("│" + "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────/▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔||▔▔\\───" + "│")
            # Put a small tail on the stats lines.
            s1 = f"  need >= {opts.wpm:3d}WPM,   avg. {avg_wpm:3d}WPM,   last {last_wpm:3d}WPM"
            s2 = f"  need >= {opts.acc:3d}% Acc, avg. {avg_acc:3d}% Acc, last {last_acc:3d}% Acc"
            lines.append(box(fill_inner(s1)[:70] + "\\\\     "))
            lines.append(box(fill_inner(s2)[:70] + "V     "))
            lines.append(bottom())
        else:
            lines.append(sep())
            lines.append(stat_wpm(opts, avg_wpm, last_wpm))
            lines.append(stat_acc(opts, avg_acc, last_acc))
            lines.append(bottom())
    else:
        lines.append(box(""))
        if opts.cat:
            lines.append(sep())
            s1 = f"  need >= {opts.wpm:3d}WPM,   avg. {avg_wpm:3d}WPM,   last {last_wpm:3d}WPM"
            s2 = f"  need >= {opts.acc:3d}% Acc, avg. {avg_acc:3d}% Acc, last {last_acc:3d}% Acc"
            lines.append(box(fill_inner(s1)[:62] + "/\\_/\\        "))
            lines.append(box(fill_inner(s2)[:62] + ">(•༝• )<      "))
            lines.append("╰" + "─" * 60 + "    |    \\───────╯")
        else:
            lines.append(sep())
            lines.append(stat_wpm(opts, avg_wpm, last_wpm))
            lines.append(stat_acc(opts, avg_acc, last_acc))
            lines.append(bottom())
    sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?25h\x1b[H" + "\n".join(lines))
    sys.stdout.flush()


def terminal_failure() -> None:
    sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?1049h")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    sys.stderr.write('Error: Os { code: 6, kind: Uncategorized, message: "No such device or address" }\n')
    sys.stderr.flush()
    raise CliExit(1)


def run_tui(opts: Opts) -> int:
    if not sys.stdin.isatty():
        terminal_failure()
    try:
        old = termios.tcgetattr(sys.stdin.fileno())
    except Exception:
        terminal_failure()

    target = new_target(opts)
    typed = ""
    lesson = 1
    ok = fail = 0
    wpms: list[int] = []
    accs: list[int] = []
    last_wpm = last_acc = 0
    started: float | None = None
    total_events = 0
    wrong_events = 0

    sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?1049h\x1b[2J\x1b[1;1H")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    try:
        tty.setraw(sys.stdin.fileno())
        render(opts, target, typed, lesson, ok, fail, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        while True:
            r, _, _ = select.select([sys.stdin], [], [], 0.25)
            if not r:
                continue
            data = os.read(sys.stdin.fileno(), 32)
            if not data:
                break
            try:
                text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
            except Exception:
                text = ""
            redraw = False
            for ch in text:
                if ch == "\x1b":
                    return 0
                if ch in ("\r", "\n", "\t"):
                    continue
                if ch in ("\x7f", "\b"):
                    if typed:
                        typed = typed[:-1]
                        total_events += 1
                        redraw = True
                    continue
                if not ch.isprintable() and ch != " ":
                    continue
                if len(typed) >= len(target) and typed != target:
                    continue
                mapped = map_char(ch, opts)
                if started is None:
                    started = time.time()
                if len(typed) < len(target):
                    if mapped != target[len(typed)]:
                        wrong_events += 1
                    typed += mapped
                    total_events += 1
                    redraw = True
                if target and typed == target:
                    elapsed = max(time.time() - (started or time.time()), 0.001)
                    non_space = sum(1 for c in target if c != " ")
                    last_wpm = int(round((non_space / 5.0) / (elapsed / 60.0)))
                    if total_events <= 0:
                        last_acc = 100
                    else:
                        last_acc = int(round(100.0 * max(0, total_events - wrong_events) / total_events))
                    wpms.append(last_wpm)
                    accs.append(last_acc)
                    if last_wpm >= opts.wpm and last_acc >= opts.acc:
                        ok += 1
                    else:
                        fail += 1
                    lesson += 1
                    target = new_target(opts)
                    typed = ""
                    started = None
                    total_events = 0
                    wrong_events = 0
                    redraw = True
            if redraw:
                avg_wpm = int(round(sum(wpms) / len(wpms))) if wpms else 0
                avg_acc = int(round(sum(accs) / len(accs))) if accs else 0
                render(opts, target, typed, lesson, ok, fail, avg_wpm, last_wpm, avg_acc, last_acc)
    finally:
        try:
            termios.tcsetattr(sys.stdin.fileno(), termios.TCSADRAIN, old)
        except Exception:
            pass
        sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?1049l\x1b[?25h")
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    try:
        opts = parse_args(sys.argv)
        return run_tui(opts)
    except CliExit as e:
        return e.code
    except BrokenPipeError:
        return 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
